stories.title: Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic's record IPO fails to stem an AI sell-off; SoftBank falls ~15%, TSMC falls 5%+, and Samsung and SK Hynix fall 6%+
Singapore-based DayOne pauses its US IPO plans to raise up to $5B as soon as Q4 amid market volatility and valuation concerns around AI infrastructure
[AINews] Anthropic successfully completes largest IPO in history, valued at $1.5T
An analysis of 10M job ads in China between 2021 and 2025 finds a double-digit decline in listings for roles more exposed to AI than for less-exposed positions
Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop Search homepage, letting users easily find and resume recent AI searches
Anthropic fell ~5% in after-hours trading on its debut day, following a record $107.3B IPO
Nscale must seek a US license to provide ByteDance remote access to Nvidia GPUs under new rules; ByteDance made up ~73% of Nscale's 2025 revenue
BrightAI, which uses AI to help industrial companies detect malfunctioning equipment, raised $97M led by Smith Point, bringing its total funding to $184M
